title: UTV repository component diagram
description: The parts of the repository and what depends on what. The specification is the source of truth; everything else encodes, checks or implements it. Nothing here is deployed: the libraries are packages an application takes in-process.

components.name: UTV repository
components.responsibility: The specification, its checks and its five libraries, versioned together for the specification and separately for each library.

components.name: Specification
components.responsibility: The normative model, decisions, result contract and traceability matrices: the source of truth for meaning.

components.name: Structural schema
components.responsibility: Field names and shapes of utv/1.0 values, as JSON Schema 2020-12.

components.name: Conformance material
components.responsibility: Structural examples, executable operation fixtures, the demo zone rules and the semantic scenarios.

components.name: Language libraries
components.responsibility: The C#, Java, Python, Rust and TypeScript libraries, each implementing the JSON layer and the typed layer.

components.name: Documentation
components.responsibility: The library contracts, the question catalogue, the example catalogue, the rationale and the generated side-by-side page.

components.name: Repository tooling
components.responsibility: The structural checks and the side-by-side page generator.

components.name: CI workflow
components.responsibility: Runs the tooling's two checks on every push and pull request.
